description: Negative: daily activity snapshot whose exerciseMinutes exceeds the minutes in a day
shaclConstraintViolated: health:DailyActivitySnapshotShape constrains health:exerciseMinutes with sh:maxInclusive 1440. 2220 exceeds the number of minutes in a day.
notes: 2220 is 37 minutes expressed in seconds. A unit error at the import boundary is the realistic way this bound gets crossed, and it is silently plausible without the constraint: 2220 is not an absurd-looking integer on its own.
